subject: QuantAI rate & model roster — request for per-1M IO pricing and options
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex@quantumai.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Quick rate + model roster request

Hey Jordan,

We're kicking off an evaluation of hosted inference for a generative agent feature at QuantumAI and want a quick, standardized view of your per-1M token IO rates (input vs output) and the list of models you currently expose on the hosted API.

High level: we expect ~2M tokens/month initially (spiky) with a mix of chat/generation and embeddings for search. Primary asks: 
- Standard per-1M token rates for input and output (hosted API) for your default recommended models
- A short model roster showing which models are available for production (and any size/latency notes)
- Any standard pilot discounts or trial credits for a new customer evaluation

CCing procurement (procurement@quantumai.io) — they may request a formal rate sheet. Appreciate anything concise (one-pager or bullets).

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Engineering, QuantumAI
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@quantumai.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick rate + model roster request

Thanks Alex — happy to help. A couple quick clarifiers so we tailor the answer:

1) Is the 2M tokens/month peak or sustained? (helps with whether to recommend Dedicated vs Hosted)
2) Typical sequence length for generation (avg prompt + response tokens) and percentage of requests that need streaming vs full-response atomic calls?
3) Any security/regulatory constraints (e.g., SOC2 required, or data residency) we should note up front?

I'll pull together a succinct sheet with per-1M IO splits for our most commonly used hosted models and include a one-page model roster. Marissa and Ben are looped in for pricing/commit guidance — Marissa will attach the official ratecard.

If useful, we can also schedule a 20-min call to walk through tradeoffs between throughput (batching) and latency.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Johnson <alex@quantumai.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@quantumai.io
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 14:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick rate + model roster request

Jordan — thanks. Answers inline: 
- The 2M tokens/month is expected average for the first 3 months; we anticipate spikes up to ~6M in experimental windows. So we'd prefer Hosted but want to understand burst behavior and cost sensitivity.
- Typical sequences: prompts ~120 tokens, outputs ~480 tokens (roughly 1:4 input:output ratio). About 30% of calls will use streaming, rest are full response.
- Security: SOC 2 is required, EU residency not required for this project (US-only for now).

Procurement asked that any returned rate sheet include per-1M input/output splits and call out any pilot credit programs. Also, procurement will want to know standard contract terms (payment net30) and whether there are volume discounts at 5M/mo and 20M/mo bands.

If you can send the sheet today, procurement will be able to triage and start an MSA review if the economics look good.

—Alex
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 May 2028 09:01:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quick rate + model roster request

Marissa / Ben — looping you in. QuantumAI (Alex) is an early-stage but high-potential prospect; they want a concise per-1M IO break for hosted plus the model roster. They expect ~2M/mo average (bursty to 6M). Procurement wants to see 5M and 20M volume bands and any pilot credits.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@quantumai.io>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, procurement@quantumai.io
Date: Fri, 24 May 2028 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick rate + model roster request

Alex — appreciate the detail. Attaching a concise packet: Redwood-Hosted-Ratecard-v2.pdf and Model-Catalog-2028.csv. Highlights below (short summary):

Pricing (hosted API, billed per 1M tokens):
- Redwood-Base-7B (recommended for low-latency small footprints): Input $1.50 / 1M, Output $3.00 / 1M
- Redwood-Chat-13B (balanced quality/latency): Input $2.50 / 1M, Output $5.00 / 1M
- Redwood-Optima-70B (high-quality, longer contexts): Input $9.00 / 1M, Output $18.00 / 1M

Standard pilot offer:
- Trial credit: $2,000 applied to first billing cycle OR 25% off hosted IO for first 30 days (one choice)
- No long-term commitment required for pilot.

Volume discount tiers (applied to combined IO spend after pilot):
- 5M+ tokens/mo: 10% discount
- 20M+ tokens/mo: 18% discount
- Committed Reserved (Dedicated) pricing available for predictable throughput — we can provide a separate quote if they expect sustained 50M+/mo.

Latency notes (typical, hosted, p50 for 1-2 token streaming bursts):
- Base-7B: p50 ~60ms, good for high-frequency small calls
- Chat-13B: p50 ~150ms
- Optima-70B: p50 ~400-600ms depending on sequence length

Other points:
- SOC 2 Type II: yes (we’ll share the certificate under NDA)
- Payment: standard Net30; procurement can request alternate terms for enterprise deals
- Model roster attached lists supported variants, max context, and recommended typical workloads.

Next steps I recommend:
1) If rates look reasonable, procurement can send a shortlist of legal terms to start MSA review.
2) We can provision a short-lived pilot (no commit) with the $2k credit and a shared mutual action plan to track success metrics.

I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (QAI-Mutual-Action-Plan.docx) that includes typical milestones (demo, trial data ingest, evaluation, procurement signoff). If you want a 20-min sync, Jordan — please propose times and I’ll join.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Pricing Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood-Hosted-Ratecard-v2.pdf (attachment), Model-Catalog-2028.csv (attachment), QAI-Mutual-Action-Plan.docx (attachment)
